messages.message: hi, my internet is barely working and i think i got overcharged on my last bill
Hello! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I'm Meera. How can I help you today?
like i said, my wifi is super slow and my bill is like 20 bucks more than usual
I need your account number and date of birth to access your details.
it's 52164119 and 06/12/1980. my name is Aisha Nair and my phone is 95591 23743
I see the network issue. I will raise a network ticket for your area.
can you just fix it now? i'm paying for high speed and i'm not getting it
The ticket is raised. Now about the billing error, I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge.
so i get my money back now?
The refund is subject to approval and will take 7-10 business days to process.
this is ridiculous. i've been waiting for a while and you're not even helping me properly 😡
Is there anything else? I have raised the ticket and the refund request. Goodbye.
